subject: I wasn't going to share this secret hack
preview_text: I built something extra for you. It solves the one thing that makes most owners quit. See it before I change my mind.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was reviewing the data last night and saw a pattern that made me wince. Most users hit a wall around week 3. Their dog's weight just... stops. And I know exactly why. It's not the plan. It's one tiny, overlooked mistake with treats.

So I stayed up and built a separate, super-simple tool. I call it the 'Treat Neutralizer'. It wasn't in the original plan, but after seeing 110+ dogs succeed, I realized this was the missing piece. It automatically adjusts your dog's entire daily meal plan in 2 seconds when you log a treat. No math, no guilt, no derailing.

It's live right now inside PupShape. Tap the 'Log a Treat' button on the home screen, and you'll see the new 'Neutralize' option. It recalculates everything on the spot so one extra biscuit doesn't undo a week of progress. This was the secret sauce for our top success stories.

Try the Treat Neutralizer now. It's my gift to you for sticking with it. Just open the app and log any treat from today. P.S. I'm only keeping this feature unlocked for users who are active this week. After that, it goes back into the vault.
